designationHistory.name: Brigantine National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission established Brigantine National Wildlife Refuge, which was combined with Barnegat in 1984 as Edwin B. Forsythe National Wildlife Refuge.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Act of 1929; Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Edwin B. Forsythe National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Edwin B. Forsythe National Wildlife Refuge: Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 1417): "The Brigantine National Wildlife Refuge was established on January 24, 1939 by the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission"; Forsythe NWR created May 22, 1984 by combining Brigantine and Barnegat NWRs

designationHistory.indexOriginal: They were established in 1939 and 1967 respectively, to protect tidal wetland and shallow bay habitat for migratory water birds.
